name: bx24-template-mcp
description: Bitrix24 MCP server — tasks, checklists, elapsed time, dependencies, and feedback. Local stdio bundle.
long_description: Gives AI assistants direct access to a Bitrix24 portal via an incoming webhook. Tasks (CRUD + 8 lifecycle actions + rating), checklist items, task results, elapsed time, dependencies, user search, plus a meta-tool to file structured feedback as a GitHub issue. Runs entirely on your machine — no server to operate, no public URL, no Bearer token. Webhook secret stays in Claude Desktop's secure user_config storage.

webhook_url.title: Bitrix24 incoming webhook URL
webhook_url.description: Full URL like https://<portal>.bitrix24.<tld>/rest/<user_id>/<secret>/. Create one under Developer resources → Other → Inbound webhook. The secret stays on your device.

github_feedback_token.title: GitHub feedback token (optional)
github_feedback_token.description: Fine-grained PAT with Issues: read/write on bitrix24/templates-mcp. Enables the bx24mcp_submit_feedback tool so the assistant can file structured issues when something is unclear. Leave empty to disable.

github_feedback_repo.title: Feedback repository
github_feedback_repo.description: owner/repo for the feedback tool. Defaults to the upstream project.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Logs go to stderr (Claude Desktop's extension log panel), never stdout.
